f5eaad69-a7d8-4c61-9912-5538f4482d84.quote: A lopsided win from lane to close. Comp read three-fifths physical for us against two-fifths for them, and only they carried a healer, Mourn; the team answered with two anti-heal items. The duo lane went ours from the jump: Adele took first blood on Lt. Belica at 7.7, and the first Fangtooth fell to us at 9.5. Steel closed the offlane by himself, killing Shinbi five separate times. The only stumble was the Fangtooth fight at 16.5, taken a body down right after Feng Mao's solo death, with Xeebs pinned across the map and unable to help — the wrong fight to start. From 18.8 on it was one-way traffic: the team won every fight after it, including five more tagged game-defining, cashing an Orb Prime and an Inhibitor along the way even as two Outer Towers fell in the trade. River control finished 19-9, and nine of ten fights went our way. Next game: when a lane is already won, rotate into the next fight, not after the tower's already gone.
